entries.text: What do you think? It's just going to come walking through the door, there? It's waited 44 years. It'll wait out there as long as it takes, until you can't stand it anymore. How long can you wait, huh? A lifetime? To live in fear like this, a young woman-- are you prepared to sacrifice family, children... And spend your life terrorized by a monster?
entries.speaker: Ernie Stefaniuk

entries.text: [ alarms beeping ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: What is that?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: It's ground radar. The sensor's set at ten feet high. Anything big enough to set it off... Is coming in through the trees.
entries.speaker: Ernie Stefaniuk

entries.text: [ thumping ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ thumping ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ thumping ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: You hear it?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: No.
entries.speaker: Ernie Stefaniuk

entries.text: Maybe I got him. Maybe I killed it. If you've got a gun, get it.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: [ ernie hyperventilating ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ hyperventilating ]

entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Agent Scully. You okay?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Yeah. I'm okay. But you're not, agent Doggett. I got you.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: [ shrieking ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Sorry I'm late. I received a fax up in my old office... From ernie's brother, myron stefaniuk.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: He's alive? Where is he?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: He doesn't say. He sent this from a small storefront business... Just across the state line in wyoming. He's gone into hiding.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Do you believe it, agent Doggett?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Believe it?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: That this thing is still out there... And someday it's going to come after us?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I'm pretty sure I hit it, agent Scully. Pretty sure you hit it, too. The guys upstairs were making some noise about this case-- about what's in our field report.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Yeah. You'll get used to it. I, uh... I never had a desk in here, agent Doggett, but I'll see that you get one.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: All right.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: And I just want to say, um... Thank you for watching my back.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Well, I never saw it as an option. I'm sure you don't either.
entries.speaker: John Doggett
